title: Four Streams Filling a Tank
devanagari: स्ते केन वासरलवेन तदा वद त्वम्॥
translation: Four streams, each opened on its own, fill a tank in one day, half a day, a third and a sixth of a day. O friend, if they are all opened together, in what fraction of a day will they fill it? Tell me.
translation_hi: चार झरने अलग अलग खोले जाने पर एक तालाब को क्रमशः एक दिन, आधे दिन, तिहाई दिन और छठे भाग दिन में भरते हैं। हे मित्र, यदि वे सब एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो वे तालाब को दिन के कितने भाग में भरेंगे? बताओ।

words.note: Same as nirjhari in the Tandava stotra.
Instrumental plural for the whole list.

grammar: Relative and correlative: ये … ते 'which (streams) … they', like यः … तस्य in Tandava verse 17.
Repetition for 'each': पृथक् पृथक् 'each on its own', like Hindi अलग अलग.
question: Together, in how many hours do they fill the tank? (Take a day as 24 hours.)
solution:
In one day the streams fill 1, 2, 3 and 6 tanks. Together: 1 + 2 + 3 + 6 = 12 tanks a day.

So one tank takes 1/12 of a day = 24/12 = 2 hours.

Bhaskara's rule: add the reciprocals of the times, then take the reciprocal of the sum. 1 / (1/1 + 1/(1/2) + 1/(1/3) + 1/(1/6)) = 1/12

Science link: this is exactly how parallel resistors combine. Conductances add like filling rates: 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + … Put resistances of 1, ½, ⅓ and ⅙ Ω in parallel and you get 1/12 Ω, the same arithmetic as the four streams.
